topic: Exception Handling and Robust Java Programs
learningObjectives: Handle runtime errors using try, catch, finally, and throw.
Create and use custom exceptions for application-specific errors.
Design error-handling flows that keep applications reliable.

activities.title: Exception Handling Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the execution path when an exception is thrown.

content.concept: When an exception is thrown inside a try block, Java searches for a compatible catch handler. If one is found, its code executes; a finally block can then perform cleanup regardless of whether an exception occurred.

goal: 5. finally block performs cleanup when present

activities.title: Try-Catch Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the role of each exception-handling component.

content.concept: The try block contains code that may throw an exception. A catch block handles a matching exception type, while finally is commonly used for cleanup that should occur after the try/catch processing.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Contains code whose exceptions may be handled.
Handles an exception compatible with the catch parameter type.
Contains code that is intended to execute after try/catch processing.
Explicitly creates and throws an exception object.

activities.title: Exception Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each failure scenario with an appropriate exception type.

content.concept: Different programming errors and invalid operations can produce different exception types. Understanding the exception helps determine appropriate handling and recovery behavior.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Array index outside valid range → ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException
Attempting to use a null reference → NullPointerException
Invalid argument supplied to a method → IllegalArgumentException

activities.title: Robust Error Handler Builder
activities.instruction: Build an exception-handling structure for invalid user input.

content.concept: Robust error handling anticipates expected failures, catches appropriate exception types, gives useful feedback, and keeps cleanup separate from normal business logic where appropriate.
